create.name: John Siddique
create.bio:
John Siddique is a British poet, author and meditation teacher whose spiritual work grew alongside a long literary career. He started meditating at thirteen, was teaching by his early twenties, and was initiated as a yogi under Sri Swami Satchidananda. After a near-death experience in 2014 he stepped away from formal labels and lineages, and his teaching since then has centred on plain awareness, honesty with oneself and kindness in daily life rather than any belief system. On the writing side he holds an MA in creative writing from Manchester, served as Poet Laureate of Canterbury and was a British Council poet in residence in Los Angeles.

His best-known spiritual book is Signposts of the Spiritual Journey, published by Watkins in 2021, which sits beside several poetry collections. Most of his teaching now happens online through The Open Space, a membership community with a monthly live satsang, recorded video talks and a yearly retreat, and through a free monthly open meditation on Zoom. He also takes on a small number of one-to-one students. On Insight Timer, where his guided meditations have been played millions of times, he offers short sits, yoga nidra and two audio courses, and his YouTube channel mixes walking meditations, short talks and poetry readings.

books.title: Signposts of the Spiritual Journey: A Practical Road Map to a Meaningful Life
books.author: John Siddique
books.description: A practical guide to treating ordinary life as the spiritual path, drawing on several contemplative traditions. Short teachings sit beside simple exercises in awareness, breath and self-enquiry, with a few of his poems along the way.

courses.title: The Open Space
courses.description: His main membership community, with a live satsang each month, video teachings, the full library of meditations and courses, and a free yearly retreat for members. Partial and full bursaries are offered on request.
courses.price: £15 GBP a month or £150 GBP a year

courses.title: Self-Acceptance Through Authenticity
courses.description: A ten-part audio course on Insight Timer that pairs short talks with guided practice, moving from general awareness towards the heart and meeting hidden patterns with kindness. It works well as a companion to his book.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Magical Moments
courses.description: An Insight Timer course of meditations and creative activities made for children, young people and families to share. It brings simple awareness practice into play and everyday home life.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: One-to-One Consultancies
courses.description: He works individually with a small number of people who want to commit more fully to their inner path. Places are limited and you write to his team to ask.

free_resources.title: John Siddique on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations, yoga nidra and reflective talks on awareness and presence, free to listen to in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Monthly Open Meditation (For All)
free_resources.description: A free group sit on Zoom once a month, open to anyone, with the joining link sent through his newsletter and Substack. Members stay on afterwards for satsang.
